answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable registration bond in a scarce asset, priced on a superlinear curve: identity N from one funding source costs N times the base, so 1,000 sybils must lock about 500,000 units instead of 1,000. Honest agents reclaim the bond; detected cheaters are slashed and their stake burned. If three agents labeled nebula, lantern and basalt all trace to one funding wallet, the shared-funding graph plus the escalating cost make the attack uneconomic.
